sqlquery.from: ( select p.name projectname, coalesce(u.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(u.lastname,'') projectmanager,t.name taskname, coalesce( xxx.timespent ,0) timespent, coalesce(xxx.approvedTimeSpent,0) approvedTimeSpent from "$".project p left join "$".myuser u on p.managerid=u.id left join "$".task t on p.id=t.projectid left join (select et.taskId, sum(tsh.timeSpent) timeSpent ,sum( case r.code when '_APPROVE' then tsh.timeSpent end) approvedTimeSpent from "$".employeetask et join "$".timesheet tsh on et.id=tsh.employeetaskId left join "$".reference r on tsh.statusid=r.id group by et.taskid ) xxx on t.id=xxx.taskId where p.isDeleted is not true and t.deleted is not true ) t
